invariants.rationale: fileIdHint is used as a key in a map, so it must not be null.
partitionPath is passed to BucketInfo constructor and should not be null.
Bucket ids are generated from totalBuckets, which is incremented, so result is non-negative.
fileIdHint was mapped to the returned bucket index.
The returned bucket index maps to a BucketInfo whose fileId matches fileIdHint.
